last_evidence.facts: Tickets 101/102 complete; M-1..M22 closed, M23 in progress. CLIP-095 delivered CI/CD canary rollout and rollback: clipos_api/deployments.py records each release as an immutable (commit SHA, image digest) pair, org-scoped and idempotent per (org, deployment_id), with a parent_deployment_id that must exist in the same org; re-registering an id with a different SHA or digest is a 409 rather than an update. Rollout is a pure transition table PENDING -> CANARY -> PROMOTED, with FAILED from PENDING/CANARY and ROLLED_BACK from CANARY/PROMOTED/FAILED; ROLLED_BACK is terminal, same-state is a no-op, anything else is 409. Promotion out of CANARY is gated by health_window_passed: the window must be non-empty and every observation HEALTHY, so a canary is promoted on evidence rather than silence; observations persist on the row and are reused. Rollback is a one-command image re-pin enforcing expand/contract: rollback_conflicts refuses with a 409 naming the offending migration when the target predates migrations this release applied; rolling back to the deployment's own revision is refused; backup restore is deliberately not modelled (DR, not rollback). release_evidence rows are append-only and idempotent per (org, deployment_id), carrying exactly the spec's Release evidence fields; rolled_back_at is stamped automatically when the deployment is already ROLLED_BACK. Audited deployments.registered, deployments.status_changed, deployments.rolled_back, release_evidence.recorded.
